name: AWS Certified Developer – Associate

fee.note: USD list price; taxes may apply. AWS charges set local-currency prices in countries that use the euro (€128), Australian dollar (A$224), Japanese yen (¥20,000), Korean won, Chinese yuan and Indian rupee (vouchers only), updated at least once a year. After you earn one AWS Certification, the next exam is 50% off.

exam.format: 65 multiple choice and multiple response questions, 130 minutes, at a Pearson VUE test center or online proctored. AWS recommends one or more years of hands-on experience developing and maintaining applications on AWS.

scope: Developing, testing, deploying and debugging applications on AWS: service APIs, SDKs and CLI, CI/CD deployment, application and data security, troubleshooting and optimization, including AI-assisted development tools and managed AI services.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: Exam version change: registration for DVA-C03 opened on October 27, 2026 and it is in use from December 1, 2026; the last day to take DVA-C02 is November 30, 2026. These facts and weights are for DVA-C03 (DVA-C02 weighted its domains 32/26/24/18%).
Renewal: recertify within 3 years by passing the latest version of this exam, or by earning the AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional, which renews this certification automatically.

discounts.text: After you earn an AWS Certification, AWS gives you a 50% discount voucher for recertification or any other AWS exam.

access.retake: After a failed attempt you wait 14 calendar days; there is no limit on attempts, but each one costs the full exam fee.
access.accommodations: Non-native English speakers taking the exam in English can request 30 extra minutes (ESL +30) once in their AWS Certification account; it then applies to every booking.

timeline.text: DVA-C03 becomes the exam (registration opened October 27, 2026).

prep.title: AWS Skill Builder: DVA-C03 exam prep plan
prep.note: The 4-step plan linked from the certification page. The Official Practice Question Set and the Exam Prep course are free; the Official Practice Exam needs a Skill Builder subscription.

domains_note: Weights from the AWS Certification Exam Guide (DVA-C03), the guide linked from the live certification page. Read 2026-11-17.
